R: bhovādī：ဘောဝါဒီ ဘော-ဝါဒိက
DOP: bho [ voc. of bhava(t) qv; S. bhos], an interjection or vocative particle used 1. in addressing one person or several persons (who are of inferior or equal status ): sir, sirs; Abh 1139 (bho are ambho); Vin II 128, 10 (evaṃ bho ti); III 1, 9 (assosi kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito; Sp 111, 21 : khalū ti anussavatthe nipāto, bho ti brāhmaṇajātikānaṃ jātisamudāgataṃ ālapanamattaṃ); 2, 2 (sutaṃ m’ etaṃ bho Gotama); D II 244, 19 (icchām’ ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ); III 17, 18 (ehi tvaṃ bho purisa); 19, 28 (tena hi bho muhuttaṃ tāva āgametha yāvāhaṃ gacchāmi); S IV 120, 33 (acchariyaṃ bho Kaccāna abbhutaṃ bho Kaccāna); Sn 427 (jīva bho); Ja I 265, 23 (bho yakkhā); II 369, 13 (rājā … bho brāhmaṇā kiṃ icchathā ti pucchi); III 528, 15* (kuto nu āgacchatha bho tayo janā; 528, 19´ : bho ti ālapanaṃ); Vibh 379, 12 (atthi kho bho eso attā yaṃ tvaṃ vadesi); Mil 79, 25 foll. (sarāhi bho sarāhi bho ti punappunaṃ sarāpeti); Mhv 7:7 (ayaṃ bho ko nu dīpo ti); 32:59 (bho Tissa mahāthūpe aniṭṭhitaṃ niṭṭhāpehi); Sadd 89, 20 foll.; 677, 25 ; 895, 3 (bho iti ekavacanabahuvacanavasena purisānaṃ itthīnaṃ ca āmantaṇe); — 2. rhetorically (in soliloquies) oh! I say! alas! (esp. with vata or khalu); Vin I 15, 14 foll. (Yaso kulaputto udānaṃ udānesi upaddutaṃ vata bho upassaṭṭhaṃ vata bho ti); D I 93, 1 (Sakyā vata bho kumārā paramasakyā vata bho kumārā ti); II 22, 20 (dhi-r-atthu kira bho jāti nāma); 37, 1 (nassati vata bho loko vinassati vata bho loko); 96, 23 (jit’ amhā vata bho ambakāya); 208, 15 (modanti vata bho devā); Ud 16, 10 (assa etad ahosi acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā); Ja I 267, 29 (aho vata bho sīlasampannānaṃ viriyaphalaṃ nāma samijjhatī ti); VI 502, 17* (acchecchuṃ vata bho rukkhaṃ); 575, 14* (dukkataṃ vata bho raññā); Mil 5, 22 foll. (Milindassa rañño etad ahosi tuccho vata bho Jambudīpo palāpo vata bho Jambudīpo); Dhp-a III 234, 14 (uppanno vata bho loke buddho ti); — °- vādi(n) , m ( fn )., one who addresses others as ‘bho’; a brahman; Abh 408; Dhp 396 (~i nāma so hoti sa ve hoti sakiñcano, akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ tam ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ; Dhp-a IV 158, 19: āmantanādīsu bho bho ti vatvā vicaranto ~ī nāma so hoti) = Sn 620; Ja VI 211, 1* (hato pi so saggam upeti ṭhānaṃ ~i ~ina mārayeyyuṃ; 214, 21´ : ~ī ti brāhmaṇā … brāhmaṇam eva māreyyuṃ, eds so ); Mp III 80, 15 (brāhmaṇā ti ~ino); — °- vādika , m ( fn )., id.; Nidd I 249, 12 (brāhmaṇā ti ye keci ~ā).
